verdict.rationale: Adyen maintains a public OpenAPI specification repository (github.com/Adyen/adyen-openapi) described as the 'single source of truth for our APIs,' usable to generate client libraries and Postman collections and explicitly positioned as context for LLMs/agents. While direct openapi.json paths on docs.adyen.com 404, the GitHub-hosted spec plus documentation-tools guidance confirms a downloadable machine-readable spec exists and is actively promoted for AI-native use. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the GitHub spec's completeness and no direct hosted endpoint on the docs domain itself.
